title: Keyboard shortcuts
description: View and edit ScholarSeed's global and file-editor shortcuts in one place. New commands and conflict handling use this catalog.
emptyDescription: Try another command name, group, or key.

editor.title: Edit “{{command}}”
editor.description: Focus the area below and press a new shortcut. {{primary}}, Option/Alt chords, and safe navigation keys are supported.
editor.invalid: Use a non-reserved chord or navigation key. Printable keys require {{primary}} or Option/Alt.
editor.conflict: Conflicts with “{{command}}” in the same scope. Choose another shortcut.

markdownUndo.title: Undo Markdown edit
markdownUndo.description: Undo the latest change in the visual Markdown editor.

markdownRedo.title: Redo Markdown edit
markdownRedo.description: Redo the latest reverted change in the visual Markdown editor.

markdownFind.title: Find in Markdown
markdownFind.description: Open in-document search in the visual Markdown editor.

markdownSelectAll.title: Select all Markdown content
markdownSelectAll.description: Select all content in the visual Markdown editor.

markdownBold.title: Toggle bold
markdownBold.description: Toggle bold formatting for the selection.

markdownItalic.title: Toggle italic
markdownItalic.description: Toggle italic formatting for the selection.

markdownStrikethrough.title: Toggle strikethrough
markdownStrikethrough.description: Toggle strikethrough formatting for the selection.

markdownInlineCode.title: Toggle inline code
markdownInlineCode.description: Toggle inline code formatting for the selection.

markdownLink.title: Insert link
markdownLink.description: Add or edit a link for the selection.

markdownParagraph.title: Set paragraph
markdownParagraph.description: Set the current block to body text.

markdownHeading1.title: Set heading 1
markdownHeading1.description: Set the current block to heading level 1.

markdownHeading2.title: Set heading 2
markdownHeading2.description: Set the current block to heading level 2.

markdownHeading3.title: Set heading 3
markdownHeading3.description: Set the current block to heading level 3.

markdownHeading4.title: Set heading 4
markdownHeading4.description: Set the current block to heading level 4.

markdownHeading5.title: Set heading 5
markdownHeading5.description: Set the current block to heading level 5.

markdownHeading6.title: Set heading 6
markdownHeading6.description: Set the current block to heading level 6.

codeSave.title: Save code file
codeSave.description: Save the current code or Markdown source file.

codeSaveAll.title: Save all
codeSaveAll.description: Save every dirty, writable file in the current project in order.

codeUndo.title: Undo code edit
codeUndo.description: Undo the latest change in the current code editor.

codeRedo.title: Redo code edit
codeRedo.description: Redo the latest reverted change in the current code editor.

codeFind.title: Find in code
codeFind.description: Open in-document search in the code editor.

codeReplace.title: Replace in code
codeReplace.description: Open find and replace in the code editor.

codeGoToLine.title: Go to line
codeGoToLine.description: Enter a line number and jump to it in the code file.

codeLineComment.title: Toggle line comment
codeLineComment.description: Toggle line comments for the current or selected lines.

codeIndent.title: Indent
codeIndent.description: Indent the current line or selection.

codeOutdent.title: Outdent
codeOutdent.description: Reduce indentation for the current line or selection.

pdfUndo.title: Undo PDF annotation
pdfUndo.description: Undo the last saved annotation change in the current PDF, including additions, edits and deletions. Text fields retain native text undo.

pdfFind.title: Find in PDF
pdfFind.description: Open in-document search for the current PDF.

pdfFindNext.title: Next match
pdfFindNext.description: Move to the next PDF search match.

pdfFindPrevious.title: Previous match
pdfFindPrevious.description: Move to the previous PDF search match.

pdfPreviousPage.title: Previous page
pdfPreviousPage.description: Go to the previous PDF page.

pdfNextPage.title: Next page
pdfNextPage.description: Go to the next PDF page.

pdfFirstPage.title: First page
pdfFirstPage.description: Go to the first PDF page.

pdfLastPage.title: Last page
pdfLastPage.description: Go to the final PDF page.

pdfGoToPage.title: Go to page
pdfGoToPage.description: Enter a page number and navigate to it in the PDF.

pdfActualSize.title: Actual size
pdfActualSize.description: Restore the PDF display scale to 100%.

pdfScrollUp.title: Scroll up
pdfScrollUp.description: Scroll upward in the PDF pages.

pdfScrollDown.title: Scroll down
pdfScrollDown.description: Scroll downward in the PDF pages.

pdfScrollLeft.title: Scroll left
pdfScrollLeft.description: Scroll left in the PDF pages.

pdfScrollRight.title: Scroll right
pdfScrollRight.description: Scroll right in the PDF pages.

pdfScrollPageDown.title: Scroll one screen down
pdfScrollPageDown.description: Scroll down by the visible PDF viewport height.

pdfScrollPageUp.title: Scroll one screen up
pdfScrollPageUp.description: Scroll up by the visible PDF viewport height.

pdfHighlight.title: Highlight selected text
pdfHighlight.description: Highlight selected PDF text with the current color; unassigned by default.

pdfComment.title: Comment on selected text
pdfComment.description: Open comment input for selected PDF text; unassigned by default.

pdfCopyText.title: Copy selected text
pdfCopyText.description: Copy the current PDF text selection; unassigned by default.
